_comment: #1061 agreed per-source genlock_latency_ms_src pins baseline (issue 866 latency half). REPORT-ONLY source of truth: scripts/latency_pins_verify.py diffs live pins vs this at OBS start and reports drift LOUD (box+input+got+want) -- it NEVER overwrites, because per-source latency is the operator's A/V-align domain. When the operator/gate LEGITIMATELY re-tunes a pin, record the new agreement by updating this file in a PR. Seeded from the live 2026-08-15 read-only WS snapshot. strih covers the default CAMERA_ACTIVE_SET (cam1/cam2/cam3); retired-grabber pins (cam4..7) are deliberately excluded so a stale pin is never checked (.claude/rules/camera-active-set.md).

stream._comment: NDI 2ME PGM is the A/V-align program hold that tracks the ~1s mastered-audio delay (~923ms design); the +/-60ms band absorbs ordinary re-tuning while still catching a gross revert (0/3/1000). Zaloha kamera (standby backup) is intentionally not pinned here.

imag._comment: imag is the low-latency IMAG projection: EVERY NDI input runs the 3ms floor, ALWAYS (imag-min-latency-3ms-always). A floor sentinel (not a per-name list) because imag's input set is dynamic/16-wide; latency_pins_verify enumerates live NDI inputs and every one must equal the floor.
